_format: flow-film v1. 15 Google Flow clips (Veo 3.1 Lite, Frames to Video, 9:16, 8 s) from pipeline-made start frames. Flow audio is used ONLY as background sound; all dialogue is fixed-voice TTS, lip-synced onto the one visible speaker. 'edit' is the cut list: the order on screen, which clip, in-point and length. 'line' = speaker on screen (lip-sync). 'vo' = heard over the shot (no lip-sync).

vo.t: Or there will be no wedding in this family.

line.t: Ma... my father is a retired teacher. Where will he find that?
My son is an engineer. I will not wed him like a nobody.

vo.t: Amara, love is not a market.

line.t: Daddy, Tobi's family has money. They saved for years. They told us so.

Tonight we celebrate! Drinks are on me!
